entries.title: What is IEEE?
entries.content: IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers) is the world's largest technical professional organization dedicated to advancing technology for the benefit of humanity.

entries.title: IEEE Mission & Vision
entries.content: IEEE's core purpose is to foster technological innovation and excellence for the benefit of humanity. Its vision is to be essential to the global technical community and to technical professionals everywhere.

entries.title: IEEE Technical Societies
entries.content: IEEE has 39 technical societies and seven technical councils representing the wide range of IEEE technical interests.

entries.title: IEEE Standards
entries.content: IEEE is a leading developer of industry standards in a broad range of technologies, including the IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi) standard.

entries.title: IEEE Xplore Digital Library
entries.content: IEEE Xplore is a digital library providing access to more than 5 million documents from IEEE and its partners, including journals, conferences, and standards.

entries.title: Student Membership Benefits
entries.content: Benefits include access to the latest technical information, networking opportunities, career resources, and discounts on conferences and publications.

entries.title: IEEE Tunisia Section
entries.content: The IEEE Tunisia Section was formed in 2008. It aims to share technical knowledge, organize events, and support student branches across Tunisia.

entries.title: IEEE ISIMM Student Branch
entries.content: The IEEE ISIMM Student Branch is a vibrant community of engineering students at ISIMM (Higher Institute of Informatics and Multimedia of Monastir). We organize workshops, competitions, and technical events.

entries.title: ISIMM SB History
entries.content: With over 6 years of activity, IEEE ISIMM SB has built a legacy of excellence, memories, and professional growth for its members.

entries.title: Technical Chapters at ISIMM SB
entries.content: ISIMM SB hosts several chapters including Computer Society (CS), Computational Intelligence (CIS), Robotics and Automation (RAS), EMBS, IAS/PES, and affinity groups like SIGHT and WIE.

entries.title: Computer Society (CS) Chapter
entries.content: The IEEE Computer Society is the premier source for information, inspiration, and collaboration in computer science and engineering.

entries.title: Robotics and Automation Society (RAS)
entries.content: IEEE RAS focuses on the advancement of the theory and practice of robotics and automation engineering and science.

entries.title: Women in Engineering (WIE)
entries.content: IEEE WIE is a global network of IEEE members and volunteers dedicated to promoting women engineers and scientists and inspiring girls to follow their academic interests in a career in engineering and science.

entries.title: Engineering in Medicine & Biology (EMBS)
entries.content: IEEE EMBS is the world's largest international society of biomedical engineers, providing a platform for sharing technical knowledge in medicine and biology.

entries.title: Computational Intelligence Society (CIS)
entries.content: IEEE CIS focuses on the theory, design, application, and development of biologically and linguistically motivated computational paradigms.

entries.title: IAS/PES Joint Chapter
entries.content: A joint chapter combining Industrial Applications (IAS) and Power & Energy (PES) societies, focusing on energy systems and industrial technical standards.

entries.title: IEEE SIGHT
entries.content: Special Interest Group on Humanitarian Technology (SIGHT) is an IEEE program that partners with underserved communities and local organizations to leverage technology for sustainable development.

entries.title: How to join IEEE ISIMM SB?
entries.content: To join IEEE ISIMM SB, you typically need to be an IEEE member and then register during our recruitment periods. Keep an eye on our social media for the registration link.

entries.title: What kind of events do you organize?
entries.content: We organize a wide range of events including technical workshops (coding, hardware), hackathons, soft skills training, and industrial visits.

entries.title: IEEE Xtreme
entries.content: IEEE Xtreme is a global, 24-hour competitive programming competition for student members.

entries.title: IEEE.tv
entries.content: IEEE.tv is an award-winning online video network made possible by the members of IEEE.

entries.title: IEEE Foundation
entries.content: The IEEE Foundation provides philanthropic support for IEEE programs that illuminate, educate, stimulate, and innovate.

entries.title: IEEE Regions
entries.content: IEEE is divided into 10 geographic regions. Tunisia is part of Region 8 (Europe, Middle East, and Africa).

entries.title: IEEE Fellows
entries.content: IEEE Fellow is a distinction reserved for select IEEE members whose extraordinary accomplishments in any of the IEEE fields of interest are deemed fitting of this prestigious grade elevation.

entries.title: Volunteer Opportunities
entries.content: Being a volunteer in IEEE ISIMM SB helps you develop leadership, communication, and management skills while contributing to the community.

entries.title: How to contact ISIMM SB?
entries.content: You can contact us via our Facebook page 'IEEE ISIMM Student Branch' or through the contact form on our website.

entries.title: IEEE Journals
entries.content: IEEE publishes nearly 200 peer-reviewed journals, which are among the most highly cited in electrical engineering, computer science, and related fields.

entries.title: Soft Skills at ISIMM SB
entries.content: Beyond technical skills, we provide training in public speaking, project management, and teamwork to prepare students for professional life.

entries.title: Goals of IEEE ISIMM SB
entries.content: Our goals include training, team building, organizing events, and inspiring creativity among engineering students.

entries.title: IEEE Branding
entries.content: IEEE uses a specific blue color, and student branches follow official branding guidelines to maintain a professional identity.

entries.title: IEEE Conferences
entries.content: IEEE sponsors more than 2,000 conferences and events worldwide each year.

entries.title: WIE ISIMM SB Activities
entries.content: The WIE affinity group at ISIMM SB organizes specific events to support and celebrate women in technical fields.
